chip.description: Serial interface controller with 16 KB of shared RAM, used for the board-to-board link on Namco System 2 and System 21 multi-cabinet games.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/namco_c139.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Namco C139 Serial" ("Namco C139 - Serial I/F Controller"). Filed io per taxonomy Q11 (network/link interfaces). MAME notes the emulation is incomplete and asks whether the part is itself an MCU with internal ROM; if that is confirmed the row needs revisiting.
